{{Quote|There's your lizard, Paxaz Izhiq."''<br />''"Not very attractive to the ladies now, is he?|CSF Captain Obrim and Clone Commando Fi discussing a body in the morgue of the Quadrant A-89 headquarters|<ref name="TripleZero" />}}
A '''Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters''' served as the base of operations for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] division assigned to [[Quadrant A-89]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The divisional headquarters was a building complex that housed various offices for [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. The CSF's [[Forensics Unit]] also operated a morgue located inside the building.<ref name="TripleZero" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> CSF [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] requested that [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] come to the morgue to identify the body of [[Paxaz Izhiq]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] member of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Izhiq was suspected of being involved with [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] cells on Coruscant that Skirata and his [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] were [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|hunting]].<ref name="TripleZero" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2006]].<ref name="TripleZero" />
